decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The vehicle crossover to which this consent relates shall be no greater in width than 2.4m

Condition : 6 - The proposal would maintain the safety of other road and footway users and would not harm the appearance of the maisonette, the surrounding area and neighbouring properties. The proposal therefore complies with policies ENV-B.1.1  (New Development), T.4.4  (Road Safety) and T.5.3  (Vehicle Crossovers and Hardstandings) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP (2003), and Section 11 (Roads, Footpaths, Parking and Servicing) of the Council's Supplementary Planning Guidance (1997).
description: The retention of a means of access to the highway.
